name: A daily rising goal starting mid-period counts only the payments made from its start date, and each payment reduces what is still reserved (G465)

expected.notes: Today is Mon 16 Nov 2026, mid pay period (last Friday: Fri 30 Oct to Thu 26 Nov, next payday Fri 27 Nov). One current account, Monzo Current, balance 400, and a savings pot, Monzo Challenge Pot (balance 60.56, never spendable). One scheduled daily goal, the invented 'Saving Challenge': a daily rising schedule of 12.12 on day one rising 4p a day, starting Fri 13 Nov 2026 (mid-period), drawn from Monzo Current, tracking payments whose description contains 'Saving Challenge'. One bill: gym 30 on Fri 20 Nov at Monzo. No salary falls inside this period (the next is 27 Nov). Plan for this period: the schedule asks for 14 daily blocks inside the period, 13 to 26 Nov. Day amounts 12.12 + 0.04 x k for k = 0..13, so the sum is 14 x 12.12 + 0.04 x (0+1+...+13) = 169.68 + 0.04 x 91 = 169.68 + 3.64 = 173.32 (the remaining target, 2,671.80 less the 60.56 already in the pot, is far larger, so the cap never binds). Payments on the paying account matching the rule: two BEFORE the schedule starts, 5 Nov 12.00 and 10 Nov 12.08 (24.08 together), and three AFTER it starts, 13 Nov 12.12, 14 Nov 12.16, 15 Nov 12.20 (36.48 together). G465: only payments from the schedule's start date count, so paid this period = 36.48, NOT 60.56. The reserve is the plan less the paid, penny-exact with no 85% snap: 173.32 - 36.48 = 136.84 (before the fix the pre-start 24.08 counted, matched 60.56, and the reserve read 112.76). Monzo walk: balance 400, gym -30 on 20 Nov, so closing and low point 370 (after payments 370). Plans reserved at Monzo (the goal's source) 136.84, so after payments and plans 370 - 136.84 = 233.16, Spend from 233.16 (its own Available, G436). The pot is savings and in no pool. Left to spend is the one counted current account: 233.16, with no buffer or other line. Headroom: lowest running balance 370 less the 136.84 reserved less the 10 every source keeps = 223.16. Nobody is short, so no cover move; the payday plan is not yet due (it shows from five days before payday, 22 Nov); at risk 0. The account stays in Upcoming By account because the plan still draws 136.84.
